By Cauchy-Schwarz,
\[
\left(\frac1x+\frac4y+\frac9z\right)(x+y+z)\ge (1+2+3)^2=36.
\]
Since \(x+y+z=1\), we get
\[
f(x,y,z)\ge 36.
\]
Equality holds when
\[
\frac{1}{x}=\frac{2}{y}=\frac{3}{z},
\]
so \(x=\frac16,\ y=\frac13,\ z=\frac12\), which satisfies \(x+y+z=1\).

Thus the minimum value is \(\boxed{36}\).
